notes.title: Update 1.02 — Localization Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi! This is a small but important update:

🌐 Localization Improvements
- Fixed issues with Japanese and Korean characters not displaying correctly — all symbols should now appear properly.

🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck on stairs for a few seconds.
- Also fixed some minor issues.

Thanks for your support and feedback — it means a lot to me as a solo developer.
I'll keep improving the game 👁️
